review_notes: Publicly listed organizational names, city/state, filtered organization website links, program type where explicit, listing-check dates and provenance only. Source assertions are not verified practice/activity status or complete membership. Historical meet observations, raw source payloads, personal contacts and athlete/coach rosters are excluded. No cross-provider name merges. Ohio alignments describe 2026-27/2027-28 placement based on 2025-26 team participation; individual-only schools are outside those lists. PVS club listings retain local codes and unknown state; cross-source duplicates remain unresolved. Supplemental summer listing retained as ordinary source-backed metadata; current operation unknown. Summer leagues are not a completeness priority. National breadth pass adds the nationwide USMS finder and Oregon, Illinois, Texas and Mississippi school swimming listings. USMS club/workout roles remain unknown; school co-ops, category/document identity and individual-entry-only context are retained; no names-only institution joins. All listing/activity statuses remain unknown. Massachusetts adds 268 winter alignment listings with published division counts matched; source co-op/ExpDate/appeal context preserved. USMS finder abbreviation labels are separate affiliations, not unique join keys. School breadth pass adds swimming-specific listings in Arizona, California Southern Section, Indiana, Kentucky, Missouri Class 1 boys, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Source editions/categories/partial universes preserved; Pennsylvania detail totals exceed summaries by one in each category (district 3), two visually struck-out Wisconsin rows excluded, co-op labels kept intact. Kentucky edition/category unknown. No verified U.S.-wide membership/activity claim. A further pass adds Connecticut girls, North Dakota boys, New Mexico alignment rows, both Iowa authorities, Rhode Island category-marked teams and Georgia GAPPS girls (not GHSA). Missouri adds boys Class 2 plus 2026 girls Classes 1/2; girls 2026-27 assignments are not yet released. Source editions, explicit unknown categories and authority boundaries retained; no names-only entity joins. Regional and state expansion adds 517 source-scoped listings across 17 documents: 161 school rows in AK/MT/WV/ME, 275 regional LSC club listings and 81 masters club/workout-group rows. All 17 cached response receipts/hashes checked; school PDFs and PNA directory visually reviewed. Unsplit categories unknown, individual-only/co-op roles retained, synthetic identities document-scoped. Two unconfirmed URLs, four inferred/single PNA cities and one multisite club city/website withheld. Regional/national overlaps remain separate assertions; no new verified activity, facilities, cross-source joins or race records. Minnesota, Idaho and Hawaii expansion: nine receipt hashes/timestamps match; 294 MN school-activity cards independently reprojected within card boundaries and requested activity filters; 63 ID alignment rows and 28 HI championship scoring rows visually reviewed. MN host/member links do not merge identities or inflate independent team claims. ID regular-season co-op markers and unknown categories retained. HI scoring-only participation does not enumerate non-scoring/league-only programs. No new pool or activity verification. GHSA 2024-25 participation survey adds 525 category-specific positive-swimming listings at 270 source school rows, separate from GAPPS. Boys/girls counts and both participant-column sums match published totals. Historical participation is not current independent-team verification; document-row identities retained, no name-based joins. Blank/all-sport totals are not swimming-team denominators. National directory expansion adds 1714 source-scoped listings across 20 documents: Florida FHSAA 2026-27 boys/girls swimming hierarchy (938), Washington WIAA 2026-27 4A/3A/2A/1A league standings widgets (241), Oklahoma OSSAA 2026-27 6A/5A classification PDFs (127), Connecticut CIAC 2026-27 boys divisions (94), Nebraska NSAA 2026-27 registered schools (82), Arkansas AAA 2026-27 conference tables (72), Nevada NIAA 2026-28 combined alignment (68), NAIA 2026 national championship qualifier institution headings (54: 26 men, 28 women), North Dakota NDHSAANOW girls team listings (19), and Adirondack Swimming LSC registered clubs (19). Document-scoped identities, co-op member notes and unknown categories preserved; contacts, athlete names and raw captures excluded. Round 2 adds 27 official high-school championship and divisional alignment sources across VA (VISAA + VHSL Northern Virginia districts), WY (WHSAA 3A/4A), SC (SCHSL 3A/4A/5A), MI (MHSAA LP D1/D2/D3 & UP), MD (MPSSAA 4A/3A & 3A/2A/1A + WMPSSDL MD), and DC (DCSAA), plus 234 YMCA dual-chartered USA Swimming club affiliations. Round 3 completes all 50 US states + DC high-school swimming resolution (adding NH, NJ, NC, DE, NY, LA, AL, CO, UT, KS, plus supplemental statewide VA and CA CIF sections CIF-OS, CIF-CS, CIF-NCS), adds NJCAA (28 programs) and 3C2A/CCCAA (110 programs) collegiate swimming, adds YMCA competitive associations (274) and national championship scoring teams (122), adds Hawaiian Swimming LSC (27 clubs) and Pacific Northwest Swimming LSC (43 clubs) plus 5 USMS LMSCs (44 clubs), and reclassifies USA Swimming/LSC youth clubs from unknown to age_group. Round 4 completes all 10/10 California CIF sections (adding CIF-SFS and CIF-SDS conference alignments), adds Tennessee TISCA/MTHSSA/KISL high-school swimming (359 programs), expands statewide Virginia VHSL Classes 1-6, North Carolina NCHSAA/NCISAA, South Carolina SCISA, and New York NYSPHSAA, completes NAIA varsity swimming, adds 13 regional YMCA swim leagues (416 programs), 8 major USA Swimming LSC directories (775 programs), 15 USMS LMSC directories (242 programs), and 9 flagship U.S. summer swim leagues (473 programs), with intra-authority deduplication across multi-year documents. Canada pass 01 adds 11 Canadian source documents: the Swimming Canada national club list (366 rows, no province or type supplied; province derived from postal codes; Content-Signal search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference recorded), Swim BC (77), Swim Alberta (121, including NWT clubs), Swim Ontario page-data (144 clubs, 199 programs), Swim Manitoba (24 clubs, 26 programs), Swim Saskatchewan age-group/summer/masters/varsity pages (36), Swim Nova Scotia (37) and Swimming NL (12). National and provincial listings of the same club remain separate assertions; no French/English alias merge was needed because no imported row carried two names. Quebec, New Brunswick and PEI clubs appear only through the national list. Canada pass 01b adds 26 browser-reviewed Canadian university swimming programs (25 varsity, Carleton as a club team) from the universities' own athletics pages observed by a person on 2026-10-23; no page bodies, hashes cover the review records; overlaps with the 12 varsity programs already imported from provincial lists stay separate. Excluded: University of Alberta: swimming discontinued after 2024-25 per its own athletics notice; Mount Royal University and UQAM: no swim program found; York University: unconfirmed, its swimming URL redirected to a general page.
